# 4 bed detached house for sale

> In quiet cul-de-sac approached by a Tree lined avenue in village setting. Traditional features of fine craftsmanship are combined with excellent Planning & Design in this Spacious Modern Built Residence using the best building materials. Provision has been made to extend into spacious attic for extra accommodation if required. Dwelling located within site bounds of c.2 acres.
